units.source_text: 当天晚上，名人也喝了适量的酒，带着三分醉意，兴高采烈、绘声绘色地说了一段相声。

en.t: That evening, the Master also drank a moderate amount of sake, and, a little tipsy, cheerfully and vividly performed a comic monologue.

units.source_text: 大竹七段也谈起少年时代的往事和家庭情况。

en.t: Otaka 7-dan also began talking about memories from his boyhood and about his family circumstances.

units.source_text: 名人向我挑战下将棋，一见我不敢上阵，就说：

en.t: The Master challenged me to a game of shogi, and when he saw that I did not dare take him on, he said:
